items.headline: Take-Two’s ‘NBA 2K’ Sales Miss Expectations Due to ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’
items.excerpt: The video-game publisher may have hurt one game’s sales with another of its own games

items.headline: Google Rolls Out New AI Chips to Challenge Nvidia
items.excerpt: Alphabet Inc.'s Google is rolling out new artificial intelligence chips, aiming to capitalize on its rapid ascent as a challenger to Nvidia Corp. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Who Could Replace Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang?
items.excerpt: If Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang steps down or is fired for having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, who could replace him? Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence says there are not many options. He is on Bloomberg Businessweek. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Nvidia-Backed Fireworks AI Notifies Customers of Its Second Hack in Weeks
items.excerpt: Fireworks AI, a popular startup that helps companies run artificial intelligence models, notified customers on Monday of a security breach in which their data was accessed, its second known hack in a matter of weeks.

items.headline: Former UK Tech Adviser Thinks Government Is Failing Startups
items.excerpt: The Treasury’s former entrepreneurship adviser has said the government is running out of time to support high-growth startups to drive economic expansion.

items.headline: 95% S&P 500, 5% Bitcoin in New Franklin ETF: Drilldown
items.excerpt: Dina Ting, head of index investments at Franklin Templeton, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss Franklin US Equity Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF (ticker: FBEQ) and Franklin US Innovation Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF (ticker: FIBT). (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Nvidia Board to Probe Spying Case After CEO Jensen Huang Admits Infidelity
items.excerpt: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy has sent the company’s stock plunging, become a focus of internal and government investigations and is now threatening to reverberate across the AI industry.

items.headline: Marvell-Lumentum Deal Odds Near Coin Flip as AI Trade Shudders
items.excerpt: Marvell Technology Inc.’s plan to double down on AI through a blockbuster $115 billion acquisition of Lumentum Holdings Inc. is getting a lukewarm early verdict from investment experts who bet on deals.

items.headline: Labor Secretary Says Department Looking to 'Modernize' BLS Data
items.excerpt: Acting US Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said that wild swings in jobs data makes the public lose trust in the information coming out of the department and that he is looking to 'modernize' that process. items.headline: 'Fluid Story' With AI, Tech Names: Cinthia Murphy
items.excerpt: Cinthia Murphy, investment strategist at TMX VettaFi, and Rob Arnott, chairman & founder of Syzygy Asset Management, join Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Anthropic Unveils New Fable, Mythos AI Models Ahead of IPO
items.excerpt: Anthropic PBC has unveiled new versions of its powerful Mythos and Fable artificial intelligence models, an effort to bolster the company’s position as a leader in AI development on the eve of its long-awaited Wall Street debut.

items.headline: Menlo: Agents Now Drive 80% of Enterprise AI Usage
items.excerpt: Enterprise AI spending has surged to $177 billion, up from $33 billion in 2025, according to Menlo Ventures’ latest State of Enterprise AI report. Partner Deedy Das says AI agents now account for 80% of usage, as businesses move beyond chatbots toward systems capable of completing complex tasks

items.excerpt: Wealth Enhancement CIO Doug Huber says the fundamental investment case for Nvidia hasn’t changed, but the investigation surrounding CEO Jensen Huang is putting leadership, succession and corporate governance more firmly into the valuation debate. items.headline: Nominal Bets on AI for Aerospace and Defense
items.excerpt: Nominal has raised new funding at a $3 billion valuation as it builds an AI and data platform for hardware engineering. CEO and cofounder Cameron McCord says revenue has grown more than 3.5-fold in eight months, with customers including five of the world’s seven largest aerospace and defense

items.headline: Binance Hackers Made Memecoins to Launder Stolen Crypto
items.excerpt: The hackers who stole $6.3 billion from Binance Holdings Ltd. in crypto’s biggest ever heist have turned to one of the sector’s most gimmicky assets to launder a slice of the proceeds: memecoins.

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Affair Draws Washington Scrutiny
items.excerpt: Bloomberg’s Carol Massar goes all in on Nvidia's investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after his affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and how the scandal is becoming a Washington national security issue putting the US-China battle over AI chips back in the spotlight. items.headline: Nvidia CEO Probe Prompts Investor Questions, Scrutiny
items.excerpt: Shares of Nvidia slumped after Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, a woman identified as a suspected Chinese spy. Wall Street experts react on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Meloni Backs Gas Price Cap to Curb Bills Ahead of Italy Election
items.excerpt: Italy advanced a plan to reimburse gas-fired power plants for part of their fuel costs, as Premier Giorgia Meloni seeks to stem the impact of a surge in energy prices on households and businesses ahead of a general election next year.

items.headline: EU Plans Crackdown on Addictive Social Media, Bot Features
items.excerpt: Social media platforms face a fresh wave of European Union curbs, this time targeting addictive features and artificial intelligence chatbots.

items.headline: US Stocks Extend Oil Relief-Driven Rally Even as Nvidia Sinks
items.excerpt: Investors piled into a risk-on relief rally Monday as US President Donald Trump said he’s unlikely to launch broad attacks on Iran, sending oil prices lower.
